title: Mock2 migration / integration finding (mock2_integration_findings row)
description: Append-only, content-hashed finding from the integration gate, finish screening, or the first-cycle migration scan of an existing project. Non-blocking migration findings become blocking when a cycle touches the affected subsystem or at the next framework-version reconciliation. Analysis that cannot conclude is recorded as analysis_incomplete — never as 'no stubs found'.

blocking.description: false when recorded at migration time; crosses to true on touched-subsystem / reconciliation

framework_version_id.description: the version the finding was recorded under (reconciliation escalation compares against the current version)

source_ref.description: hash/id reference to the change record or framework audit that produced it
